name: external_shell
why: The twin of «internal_shell», with the opposite direction. Outward, the solid of before becomes the void and the wall is added from outside: 110 x 70 x 45 - 240000 = 106500 mm3, and the bounding box GROWS. It is the bounding box that makes this check different from a comparison of volumes: a shell that got the direction wrong would leave the bounding box where it was.

expect.tolerance_why: the operation rounds to the tenth before reporting it
